g.text: Everybody Votes — D2-A: Vote and Error Flow

g.title: next
g.text: Not recorded: allow manual retry if open
Unknown: ask user to check again

svg.text: Goal: Validate and record eligible votes once; reject invalid or duplicate requests and recover safely from uncertain writes.
Legend: Rounded box = action / outcome; diamond = decision; solid arrow = possible transition.
HTTP status labels = response outcomes; status-check branch = recovery after an uncertain write.
